title: Bounded connection admission is the liveness fix
summary: The accepted architecture uses fixed worker activities plus bounded FIFO, not one activity per unauthenticated accepted peer. Default workers=16 and pending=64; overflow closes the just-accepted socket and releases pinned resources immediately.
invariants: Do not reintroduce conn~start fan-out per pre-TLS peer.
A Foreign Runtime introspection race fix is separate from HTTPS reset-storm liveness.
Pin TLS/config generation at accept/enqueue time.
Queue overflow must not retain leases/resources.
